Metrics and Targets                                                          指標及目標

Climate-related Targets                                                      氣候相關目標

To effectively implement management measures for climate-related             為有效落實氣候相關風險與機遇的管理
risks and opportunities, Yihai International has set a greenhouse gas        舉措，頤海國際以2021 年為基準，5 年
(GHG) emission reduction target using 2021 as the base year and a            為週期，設立溫室氣體減排目標：溫室
five-year cycle: the GHG emission intensity will gradually decrease,         氣體排放密度逐步下降，至 2026 年較
aiming for a 3% reduction by 2026 compared to 2021, with progress            2021年下降3%，並持續監察進展。本目
continuously monitored. The setting of this target comprehensively           標設定綜合考慮現有業務結構、發展規
considers the existing business structure, development plans, and            劃及內部管理需求，參考了《巴黎協定》
internal management needs. It references global temperature control          等國際協議所導向的全球溫控目標，並
goals guided by international agreements such as the Paris Agreement         考量了中國政府提出的「雙碳」戰略下的
and considers the Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)                 國家自主貢獻(NDCs)路徑，以確保與最
pathways under the “Dual Carbon” strategy proposed by the Chinese            新氣候變化國際協議的承諾方向一致。
government to ensure alignment with the commitment directions of the

     (iv)    Accounting policies of leases                                         (iv)    租賃會計政策

             Leases are recognised as a right-of-use asset and a                           在本集團預期可使用租賃資產
             corresponding liability at the date at which the leased asset                 之日，租賃應確認為使用權資
             is available for use by the Group.                                            產和相應負債。

             Contracts may contain both lease and non-lease                                合約可包含租賃及非租賃部
             components. The Group allocates the consideration in the                      分。本集團根據其相對獨立的
             contract to the lease and non-lease components based on                       價格將合約的代價分配至租賃
             their relative stand-alone prices. However, for leases of real                及非租賃部分。然而，就本集
             estate for which the Group is a lessee, it has elected not                    團作為承租人租賃房地產而
             to separate lease and non-lease components and instead                        言，其已選擇不區分租賃及非
             accounts for these as a single lease component.                               租賃部分，而是將該等租賃入
                                                                                           賬作為單一租賃部分。

      8.    LEASES (Continued)                                                        8.   租賃（續）

            (iv)   Accounting policies of leases (Continued)                               (iv)   租賃會計政策（續）

                   Lease terms are negotiated on an individual basis and                          租賃條款乃按個別基準磋商，
                   contain a wide range of different terms and conditions. The                    並包含各種不同的條款及條
                   lease agreements do not impose any covenants other than                        件。除出租人所持租賃資產的
                   the security interests in the leased assets that are held by                   擔保權益外，租賃協議並無施
                   the lessor. Leased assets may not be used as security for                      加任何契諾。租賃資產不得用
                   borrowing purposes.                                                            作借款擔保。

                   The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate                      租賃付款額按照租賃內含利率
                   implicit in the lease. If that rate cannot be determined, the                  折現。如果無法確定該利率，
                   lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is used, being the rate                    則應採用承租人的增量借款利
                   that the individual lessee would have to pay to borrow                         率，即個別承租人為在類似經
                   the funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value in                     濟環境下獲得價值相近的資
                   a similar economic environment with similar terms and                          產，以類似條款和條件借入資
                   conditions.                                                                    金而必須支付的利率。

                   To determine the incremental borrowing rate, the Group:                        為釐定增量借款利率，本集
                                                                                                  團：

                   •     where possible, uses recent third-party financing                        •   在可能情況下，使用個
                         received by the individual lessee as a starting point,                       別承租人最近獲得的第
                         adjusted to reflect changes in financing conditions                          三方融資為出發點作出
                         since third party financing was received,                                    調整以反映自獲得第三
                                                                                                      方融資以來融資條件的
                                                                                                      變動，

                   •     uses a build-up approach that starts with a risk-free                    •   使用累加法，首先就本
                         interest rate adjusted for credit risk for leases held                       集團所持有租賃的信用
                         by the Group, which does not have recent third party                         風險（最近並無第三方融
                         financing, and                                                               資）調整無風險利率，及

                   •     makes adjustments specific to the lease, e.g. term,                      •   進行特定於租約的調
                         country, currency and security.                                              整，例如期限、國家、
                                                                                                      貨幣及抵押。

                   Right-of-use asset are generally depreciated over the shorter                  使用權資產一般於資產的可使
                   of the asset’s useful life and the lease term on a straight-line               用年期及租賃期（以較短者為
                   basis. If the Group is reasonably certain to exercise a                        準）內按直線法予以折舊。倘
                   purchase option, the right-of-use asset is depreciated over                    本集團合理確定行使購買選擇
                   the underlying asset’s useful life.                                            權，則使用權資產於相關資產
                                                                                                  的可使用年期內予以折舊。

                   Payments associated with short-term leases are recognised                      與短期租賃相關的付款按直線
                   on a straight-line basis as an expense in profit or loss.                      法於損益確認為開支。短期租
                   Short-term leases are leases with a lease term of 12 months                    賃指租賃期為 12 個月或以下
                   or less without a purchase option.                                             的租賃且並無購買選擇權。

                   See Note 38(j) for the other accounting policies relevant to                   有關租賃的其他會計政策，請
                   leases.                                                                        參閱附註38(j)。

34. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                           34. 關聯方交易

   Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability,        如一方有能力直接或間接控制另一
   directly or indirectly, to control the other party or exercise            方或對另一方作出財務及經營決策
   significant influence over the other party in making financial            行使重大影響力，則各方被視為有
   and operation decisions. Parties are also considered to be                關聯。如彼等受共同控制，各方亦
   related if they are subject to common control. Members of key             被視為有關聯。本集團主要管理層
